optional.params: JSON value, missing/null => None at generic envelope, but selected typed methods require object params

request.jsonrpc: neither sent nor required; unknown-field runtime behavior beyond fixture NOT_RUN

response.same_id: exact variant/value, distinguish string 7 vs integer 7; no Number rounding or integer->string rewrite

notification.server: {method,params,emittedAtMs?}; emittedAtMs i64, omitted when None; current sender supplies it
notification.timestamp_units: emittedAtMs/item lifecycle = milliseconds; Thread/Turn epoch fields = seconds; durationMs = milliseconds

serialization_rules.field_semantics: Option<T> normally decodes missing/null as None and serializes None as null unless skip; booleans with serde(default) accept missing=false, reject null; per-field special serializer/predicate retained below. Structs generally accept unknown fields absent deny_unknown_fields; unsupported fields still require explicit admission/qualification disposition.
serialization_rules.field_filtering: Descriptors below give Rust type serialization. Experimental stripping/transport media redaction are separate runtime concerns; cross-connection output filtering and exact outgoing omission of all nested experimental values NOT_QUALIFIED.
serialization_rules.notable_input_key: UserInput::Text serializes text_elements, not textElements: enum rename_all does not rename fields; TextElement is separately camelCase.

critical_incompatibilities.fact: PRD0030 requires native institutional decision; selected thread/resume is thread lifecycle; client server-request response is not that authority. Native applyResume checks checkpoint and pendingApprovalId.
critical_incompatibilities.proposal: Retain PENDING as turn.status=inProgress and thread.status={type:active,activeFlags:[waitingOnApproval]}; expose institutional state/decision through separate authorized CVG surface. Poll thread/read if limited to selected notifications; do not invent approval notification or forge command/file approval. Native exact binding/attempt/fence checks remain mandatory. Reject/hold unadmitted wire approval replies; never write approvals from them.

critical_incompatibilities.fact: dispatchRespond prioritizes trimmed responseText; only otherwise composes nonempty responseIntent. composeResponse calls runModelCall with purpose RESPONSE, context run.input.context; prose saying use observations is not evidence of full tool-result admission.
critical_incompatibilities.proposal: Map only admitted final answer to agentMessage. Qualify direct responseText separately. For responseIntent require actual model-bound full admitted result per PAR0224; no summaries, synthetic call or swapped result. Root snapshot is not proof of a different owner candidate.

critical_incompatibilities.fact: Selected provider API is execute -> Promise<ProviderResult> with complete text. Reference forwards AgentMessageContentDelta as notification independently from completion.
critical_incompatibilities.proposal: Lead must add governed incremental provider/runtime event path. Preserve item identity, admission/cancel/deadline/budget and first cause; persist before publication under bounded queue. Hold synthetic terminal until first delta observed. Do not claim current complete-result API satisfies CQ06.

critical_incompatibilities.fact: RPC id is transport correlation; notifications lack eventId/sequence/ACK/cursor. emittedAtMs is emission time. thread/read/resume hydrate history; backwards cursors are for other list methods, not CVG delivery ACK. SessionEventRead has afterSequence and limit.
critical_incompatibilities.proposal: Maintain durable native event->wire projection and resource-id bindings, retaining original payload/time across replay. Native cursor/ACK lives on separately versioned CVG API. Reconnecting Codex client initializes then thread/resume/read for history and future notifications; no claim of exact missing-delta replay or cross-process pending RPC continuation absent additional approved contract. Lead owns persistence transactions/DDL and delivery semantics.

critical_incompatibilities.topic: native tools vs client dynamic tool execution
critical_incompatibilities.fact: Reference item/tool/call delegates tool execution to client after canonical DynamicToolCall start. CQ02/CQ04/CQ05 require registry/policy/approval and bodies native.
critical_incompatibilities.proposal: Use native registry execution; never solicit client tool success as proof of native execution. Optional dynamicToolCall item lifecycle for native READ/WRITE is a GOVERNED projection only, pending explicit rule. Do not emit item/tool/call for those bodies. Command/file-change approvals are outside this native registry path; no server approval request is required for the selected journey. External dynamic tool execution remains UNSUPPORTED/NOT_RUN.

critical_incompatibilities.fact: turn/start may return existing turn via Steered; empty turnId interrupts startup; interrupt {} also returned on TurnComplete.
critical_incompatibilities.proposal: Lead must implement source behavior or keep variants unsupported with explicit qualification disposition; do not claim one request=one new turn or every interrupt ACK=interrupted. Preserve native commit order and effect facts.

critical_incompatibilities.topic: required metadata, branding, profiles and narrowing
critical_incompatibilities.fact: Thread and Start/Resume responses carry required environment/model/policy/source/history fields with nullable values; no generic SDK result substitutes them.
critical_incompatibilities.proposal: Populate truthful composition-bound facts and native persistent metadata. Fields without honest mapping stay unsupported, not fabricated OpenAI branding/configuration. Non-null unknown tagged variants and smaller input domains retain NOT_RUN obligations. Literal vs governed comparator rules require explicit approval.

critical_incompatibilities.fact: Wire TurnStatus has only completed/interrupted/failed/inProgress. There is no uncertain or waitingApproval terminal variant.
critical_incompatibilities.proposal: Do not flatten native UNKNOWN/UNCERTAIN into successful/failed confirmed effect. Keep authoritative settlement and first cause on CVG surface; wait uses inProgress plus activeFlags when known. Exact terminal/error projection for uncertain outcomes remains Lead decision/rule, unqualified until settled.

concrete_projection_proposal.physical_paths: recommendation only; Lead owns canonical export/package/store/DDL selection
sequence: initialize -> truthful CVG environment metadata; initialized is notification only
thread/start -> native durable thread/session binding -> ThreadStartResponse then thread/started
turn/start text -> native execution -> response Turn(inProgress,notLoaded,[]) plus turn/started
native READ -> registry/policy/budget -> real result -> admitted observations/context; proposed dynamicToolCall lifecycle is governed-only because body is native, no item/tool/call
WRITE waits -> turn remains inProgress; thread/read status.activeFlags=[waitingOnApproval]; institutional decision on native CVG port; guarded resume exact bindings; no wire response mutates approval
responseIntent -> governed RESPONSE call with full admitted result; responseText -> direct final provenance, separate case
incremental provider text -> durable native event -> item/started agentMessage -> deltas before terminal -> item/completed; errors retain first cause
native persisted terminal -> turn/completed, summary last agentMessage only or notLoaded empty; interrupt {} is only correlated response
new connection -> initialize -> thread/resume/read from durable views; CVG replay/ACK separate. Never infer delivery acknowledgment from snapshot.

concrete_projection_proposal.unsupported_policy: Do not silently drop unsupported params, ignore their semantics or synthesize successful output; explicit NOT_SUPPORTED/NOT_RUN qualification disposition is required. Exact compatible error for each variant is NOT_RESOLVED; cannot claim literal wire parity.
